The Chinese characters for Liam

As a transliteration, Liam is usually written 利亚姆 (Lì yà mǔ). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

利
Lì
sharp, benefit
亚
yà
Asia, second
姆
mǔ
nursemaid, mother

Origin and meaning

The name Liam has Irish roots and means “resolute protector (short form of William)”.

About the name Liam

An Irish short form of William that has topped recent US charts.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Liam suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
